strategy.name: Aggressive Momentum (Paper)
strategy.desc: Short-to-medium-hold momentum and breakout trades in high-beta names, leveraged sector ETFs, and crypto proxies. Rides relative strength with trailing stops; cuts losers fast. Aggressive sizing inside hard guardrails — paper only.
rules: Enter on a breakout above a 20-day base with above-average volume and positive relative strength.
Size by risk: shares = (10% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), capped at 40% of equity per name.
Initial stop below the breakout pivot; switch to an ~18% trailing stop once +8% in profit.
Take partial profit at +6–8%; let the remainder trail.
No new entries if the daily loss halt (−10%) is hit; flatten and stop for the month at −30%.
Leveraged ETFs and crypto sized smaller — leverage already amplifies the move.
